(minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213\t\n214\t        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215\t        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216\t            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n218\t            return;\n219\t        }\n220\t\n221\t        // Subdivide into 8 children\n222\t        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223\t        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224\t\n225\t        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226\t            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n227\t\n228\t            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n229\t            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n230\t                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n231\t                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n232\t                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n233\t                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n234\t\n235\t                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n236\t                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n237\t                }\n238\t            }\n239\t        }\n240\t\n241\t        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242\t        bool canSplit = false;\n243\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n244\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n245\t                canSplit = true;\n246\t                break;\n247\t            }\n248\t        }\n249\t\n250\t        if (!canSplit) {\n251\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n252\t            return;\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Build children\n256\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n257\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n258\t                Vec3 childMin = center;\n259\t                Vec3 childMax = center;\n260\t                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n261\t                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n262\t                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n263\t                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n264\t                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n265\t                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n266\t\n267\t                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n268\t                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n269\t                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n315\t// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n316\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i 0);\n575\t    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n576\t    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n577\t    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t            if (i == j) continue;\n598\t            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n599\t                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n600\t        }\n601\t        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// ============================================================================\n663\t\n664\tvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n665\t    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n666\t\n667\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n668\t        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n669\t        int bestT = 0;\n670\t\n671\t        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n672\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n673\t            val_t sum = ZERO;\n674\t\n675\t            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n676\t                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n677\t                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n678\t                sum += pS * pB;\n679\t            }\n680\t\n681\t            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n682\t                maxCorr = sum;\n683\t                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n684\t            }\n685\t        }\n686\t\n687\t        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n688\t    }\n689\t}\n690\t\n691\t// ============================================================================\n692\t// Validation\n693\t// ============================================================================\n694\t\n695\tbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n696\t    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n697\t\n698\t    // Check that distances are non-negative\n699\t    bool allNonNegative = true;\n700\t    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n701\t    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n702\t    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n703\t    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n704\t\n705\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n706\t        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n707\t        if (d < 0) {\n708\t            allNonNegative = false;\n709\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n710\t        }\n711\t        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n712\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n713\t            return false;\n714\t        }\n715\t        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n716\t        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n717\t        sumDist += d;\n718\t        if (d > { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t   Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Octree for Spatial Acceleration (built on the host, flattened for the GPU)\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\nconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n\nclass Octree {\npublic:\n    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = &triangles;\n        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n\n        // Compute bounding box\n        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n\n        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n        minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// Flattened octree node: c = (center.xyz, first), h = (halfExtent.xyz, count).\n// Leaves (count > 0) reference `count` entries of the leaf triangle array starting at\n// `first`; inner nodes (count < 0) have -count children stored contiguously at `first`.\nstruct FlatOctree {\n    std::vector<float4> nodeC, nodeH;\n    std::vector<float4> leafTris;  // per entry: v0 (w = index bits), e1, e2\n    int maxDepth = 0;\n};\n\nvoid flattenOctree(const Octree& root, const std::vector<Triangle>& tris, FlatOctree& out) {\n    std::vector<const Octree*> nodes{&root};\n    std::vector<int> depth{0};\n    out.nodeC.resize(1);\n    out.nodeH.resize(1);\n    for (size_t n = 0; n < nodes.size(); ++n) {\n        const Octree* node = nodes[n];\n        int first, count;\n        if (!node->triangleIndices.empty()) {\n            first = static_cast<int>(out.leafTris.size() / 3);\n            count = static_cast<int>(node->triangleIndices.size());\n            for (size_t idx : node->triangleIndices) {\n                const Triangle& t = tris[idx];\n                Vec3 e1 = t.b - t.a;\n                Vec3 e2 = t.c - t.a;\n                out.leafTris.push_back(make_float4(t.a.x, t.a.y, t.a.z,\n                                                   __int_as_float(static_cast<int>(idx))));\n                out.leafTris.push_back(make_float4(e1.x, e1.y, e1.z, 0.0f));\n                out.leafTris.push_back(make_float4(e2.x, e2.y, e2.z, 0.0f));\n            }\n        } else {\n            first = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());\n            count = 0;\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                if (node->children[i]) {\n                    nodes.push_back(node->children[i].get());\n                    depth.push_back(depth[n] + 1);\n                    out.maxDepth = std::max(out.maxDepth, depth[n] + 1);\n                    ++count;\n                }\n            }\n            out.nodeC.resize(nodes.size());\n            out.nodeH.resize(nodes.size());\n            count = -count;\n        }\n        out.nodeC[n] = make_float4(node->center.x, node->center.y, node->center.z,\n                                   __int_as_float(first));\n        out.nodeH[n] = make_float4(node->halfExtent.x, node->halfExtent.y, node->halfExtent.z,\n                                   __int_as_float(count));\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation: std::mt19937 (seed 42) + uniform_real_distribution<float>\n// ============================================================================\n//\n// The stream is split into \"twist blocks\" of 624 outputs. Block k consists of the\n// tempered words of the generator state after k+1 twists. The host advances the raw\n// state and records a snapshot every RNG_JOB_BLOCKS blocks; the device regenerates\n// RNG_JOB_BLOCKS blocks from each snapshot.\n\nconstexpr int MT_N = 624;\nconstexpr int MT_M = 397;\nconstexpr uint32_t MT_UPPER = 0x80000000u;\nconstexpr uint32_t MT_LOWER = 0x7fffffffu;\nconstexpr uint32_t MT_MATRIX = 0x9908b0dfu;\nconstexpr int RNG_JOB_BLOCKS = 8;          // twist blocks generated per snapshot\nconstexpr size_t BATCH_BLOCKS = 16384;     // twist blocks per batch (multiple of 4)\nconstexpr int VALUES_PER_PAIR = 4 * NUM_RAYS;\nstatic_assert((BATCH_BLOCKS * MT_N) % VALUES_PER_PAIR == 0, \"batch must hold whole pairs\");\nstatic_assert(BATCH_BLOCKS % RNG_JOB_BLOCKS == 0, \"batch must hold whole jobs\");\nconstexpr size_t BATCH_PAIRS = BATCH_BLOCKS * MT_N / VALUES_PER_PAIR;\nconstexpr size_t BATCH_JOBS = BATCH_BLOCKS / RNG_JOB_BLOCKS;\n\nclass HostMersenneState {\npublic:\n    uint32_t mt[MT_N];\n\n    explicit HostMersenneState(uint32_t seed) {\n        mt[0] = seed;\n        for (int i = 1; i < MT_N; ++i) {\n            mt[i] = 1812433253u * (mt[i - 1] ^ (mt[i - 1] >> 30)) + static_cast<uint32_t>(i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    static uint32_t mag(uint32_t y) { return (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? MT_MATRIX : 0u); }\n\n    void twist() {\n        int k = 0;\n        for (; k < MT_N - MT_M; ++k) {\n            uint32_t y = (mt[k] & MT_UPPER) | (mt[k + 1] & MT_LOWER);\n            mt[k] = mt[k + MT_M] ^ mag(y);\n        }\n        for (; k < MT_N - 1; ++k) {\n            uint32_t y = (mt[k] & MT_UPPER) | (mt[k + 1] & MT_LOWER);\n            mt[k] = mt[k + (MT_M - MT_N)] ^ mag(y);\n        }\n        uint32_t y = (mt[MT_N - 1] & MT_UPPER) | (mt[0] & MT_LOWER);\n        mt[MT_N - 1] = mt[MT_M - 1] ^ mag(y);\n    }\n};\n\n// Tempering + generate_canonical<float, 24> (exactly as libstdc++ does it)\n__device__ __forceinline__ float mtToFloat(uint32_t y) {\n    y ^= (y >> 11);\n    y ^= (y << 7) & 0x9d2c5680u;\n    y ^= (y << 15) & 0xefc60000u;\n    y ^= (y >> 18);\n    float r = __fmul_rn(__uint2float_rn(y), 2.3283064365386963e-10f);  // / 2^32 (exact)\n    return r >= 1.0f ? 0.99999994f : r;\n}\n\n// One block per snapshot; MT_N threads; each block writes RNG_JOB_BLOCKS * MT_N values.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(MT_N)\ngenerateRandomKernel(const uint32_t* __restrict__ snapshots, float* __restrict__ out, int numJobs) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t mt[MT_N];\n    const int job = blockIdx.x;\n    if (job >= numJobs) return;\n    const int k = threadIdx.x;\n    mt[k] = snapshots[static_cast<size_t>(job) * MT_N + k];\n    float* dst = out + static_cast<size_t>(job) * RNG_JOB_BLOCKS * MT_N;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int b = 0; b < RNG_JOB_BLOCKS; ++b) {\n        dst[b * MT_N + k] = mtToFloat(mt[k]);\n        if (b + 1 == RNG_JOB_BLOCKS) break;\n\n        // Parallel twist in three dependency phases\n        uint32_t y = 0;\n        if (k < MT_N - 1) y = (mt[k] & MT_UPPER) | (mt[k + 1] & MT_LOWER);\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (k < MT_N - MT_M) mt[k] = mt[k + MT_M] ^ HostMersenneStateMag(y);\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (k >= MT_N - MT_M && k < 2 * (MT_N - MT_M))\n            mt[k] = mt[k + (MT_M - MT_N)] ^ HostMersenneStateMag(y);\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (k >= 2 * (MT_N - MT_M) && k < MT_N - 1)\n            mt[k] = mt[k + (MT_M - MT_N)] ^ HostMersenneStateMag(y);\n        if (k == MT_N - 1) {\n            y = (mt[MT_N - 1] & MT_UPPER) | (mt[0] & MT_LOWER);\n            mt[MT_N - 1] = mt[MT_M - 1] ^ HostMersenneStateMag(y);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device geometry helpers\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 f3(const float4& v) { return Vec3(v.x, v.y, v.z); }\n\n// Ray (segment p1-p2) vs. node bounding box, identical to the sequential test\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,\n                                                 const Vec3& center, const Vec3& halfExtent) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Möller-Trumbore with precomputed edges e1 = v1 - v0, e2 = v2 - v0\n__device__ __forceinline__ val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                                      const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& e1, const Vec3& e2) {\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLOAT_MAX;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLOAT_MAX;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLOAT_MAX;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\nconstexpr int OCTREE_STACK = 128;\n\n// Is the segment between two points blocked by any triangle other than src/dst?\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                             const float4* __restrict__ nodeC, const float4* __restrict__ nodeH,\n                             const float4* __restrict__ leafTris, int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n    const val_t maxDist = rayLen - EPSILON;\n\n    int stack[OCTREE_STACK];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const int n = stack[--sp];\n        const float4 c = __ldg(&nodeC[n]);\n        const float4 h = __ldg(&nodeH[n]);\n        // The root box is not tested by the sequential traversal\n        if (n != 0 && !rayIntersectsBox(from, to, f3(c), f3(h))) continue;\n        const int first = __float_as_int(c.w);\n        const int count = __float_as_int(h.w);\n        if (count > 0) {\n            for (int k = first; k < first + count; ++k) {\n                const float4 a = __ldg(&leafTris[3 * k]);\n                const int idx = __float_as_int(a.w);\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                const float4 e1 = __ldg(&leafTris[3 * k + 1]);\n                const float4 e2 = __ldg(&leafTris[3 * k + 2]);\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, f3(a), f3(e1), f3(e2));\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < maxDist) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Push children in reverse so they are visited in the original order\n            for (int k = first - count - 1; k >= first; --k) stack[sp++] = k;\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    val_t c = v.dot(normal) / vNorm;\n    return c > ZERO ? c : ZERO;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 pointInTriangle(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b, const Vec3& c,\n                                                val_t u, val_t v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = b - a;\n    Vec3 ac = c - a;\n    return a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation kernels\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct DevTriangles {\n    const float4* a;\n    const float4* b;\n    const float4* c;\n    const float4* n;  // normal (w = area)\n};\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool pairCulled(const DevTriangles& t, int i, int j) {\n    return f3(__ldg(&t.n[i])).dot(f3(__ldg(&t.n[j]))) > 0.99f;\n}\n\n// tauT[j * N + i] = tau(i, j); diagonal 0\n__global__ void tauKernel(DevTriangles t, int* __restrict__ tauT, int N) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const int j = blockIdx.y;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n    int tau = 0;\n    if (i != j) {\n        Vec3 ci = (f3(t.a[i]) + f3(t.b[i]) + f3(t.c[i])) / 3.0f;\n        Vec3 cj = (f3(t.a[j]) + f3(t.b[j]) + f3(t.c[j])) / 3.0f;\n        val_t dist = (ci - cj).norm();\n        tau = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n    }\n    tauT[static_cast<size_t>(j) * N + i] = tau;\n}\n\nconstexpr int ROW_THREADS = 256;\n\n// Number of non-culled pairs (i, j), j != i, per row i\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(ROW_THREADS)\ncountPairsKernel(DevTriangles t, unsigned long long* __restrict__ rowCount, int N) {\n    __shared__ int warpSums[ROW_THREADS / 32];\n    const int i = blockIdx.x;\n    int cnt = 0;\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < N; j += ROW_THREADS) {\n        if (j != i && !pairCulled(t, i, j)) ++cnt;\n    }\n    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) cnt += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, cnt, o);\n    if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0) warpSums[threadIdx.x >> 5] = cnt;\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        unsigned long long s = 0;\n        for (int w = 0; w < ROW_THREADS / 32; ++w) s += warpSums[w];\n        rowCount[i] = s;\n    }\n}\n\n// Ordered compaction of non-culled pairs, packed as (i << 16) | j\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(ROW_THREADS)\nfillPairsKernel(DevTriangles t, const unsigned long long* __restrict__ rowOffset,\n                uint32_t* __restrict__ pairs, int N) {\n    __shared__ int warpSums[ROW_THREADS / 32];\n    const int i = blockIdx.x;\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    unsigned long long base = rowOffset[i];\n    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < N; j0 += ROW_THREADS) {\n        const int j = j0 + threadIdx.x;\n        const bool keep = j < N && j != i && !pairCulled(t, i, j);\n        const unsigned ballot = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, keep);\n        if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = __popc(ballot);\n        __syncthreads();\n        int before = 0, total = 0;\n        for (int w = 0; w < ROW_THREADS / 32; ++w) {\n            if (w < warp) before += warpSums[w];\n            total += warpSums[w];\n        }\n        if (keep) {\n            const int rank = before + __popc(ballot & ((1u << lane) - 1u));\n            pairs[base + rank] = (static_cast<uint32_t>(i) << 16) | static_cast<uint32_t>(j);\n        }\n        base += total;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\nconstexpr int KIJ_THREADS = 128;\n\n// One thread per (pair, ray); 16 consecutive lanes form one pair.\n// Writes the form factor transposed: kijT[j * N + i] = Kij.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(KIJ_THREADS)\nformFactorKernel(const uint32_t* __restrict__ pairs, size_t numPairs,\n                 const float* __restrict__ rnd, DevTriangles t,\n                 const float4* __restrict__ nodeC, const float4* __restrict__ nodeH,\n                 const float4* __restrict__ leafTris, float* __restrict__ kijT, int N) {\n    const size_t gt = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * KIJ_THREADS + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t p = gt / NUM_RAYS;\n    const int r = static_cast<int>(gt % NUM_RAYS);\n    const bool active = p < numPairs;\n\n    val_t contrib = ZERO;\n    int i = 0, j = 0;\n    if (active) {\n        const uint32_t packed = pairs[p];\n        i = static_cast<int>(packed >> 16);\n        j = static_cast<int>(packed & 0xffffu);\n        const float4 rv = *reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(rnd + p * VALUES_PER_PAIR + 4 * r);\n\n        const Vec3 nI = f3(__ldg(&t.n[i]));\n        const Vec3 nJ = f3(__ldg(&t.n[j]));\n        const Vec3 pI = At n=5120 with 100 timesteps, the computation now takes **158 ms instead of 513 s**, and the results match the original's **in every case I tested**.\n\n| Triangles (`-t 100`) | Original | CUDA |\n|---|---|---|\n| 320 | 1.5 s | 4 ms |\n| 1280 | 26.8 s | 20 ms |\n| 5120 | 513 s | 158 ms |\n| 20480 | hours (not run) | 2.7 s |\n\n**One thing to know first:** the outputs match a build of the original with floating-point fusion (FMA) turned off, not the stock build. The stock build fuses multiply-adds on this CPU, and that alone changes one distance at n=1280. So no CUDA version can reproduce the stock build's hash exactly. I now build both the CPU and GPU code with strict IEEE arithmetic (`-ffp-contract=off` on the host, `--fmad=false` on the GPU). Against that reference, the program output and hash at 20, 80, 320, 1280 and 5120 triangles (various `-t`, `-s`, `-r`) are identical, apart from the timing lines.\n\n**How it works:**\n- **Form factors (the slow part):** The original draws all its random numbers from one `std::mt19937` stream, in a fixed pair order. To get the same numbers in parallel:\n  - The GPU lists the pairs that aren't skipped, so each pair knows its position in the stream.\n  - CPU threads save the generator's state every 32 refills; worker threads use jump-ahead to skip directly to their part of the stream.\n  - The GPU regenerates the actual numbers from those saved states.\n  - Work is split across all 4 GPUs, overlapped with the CPU threads.\n- **Ray tests:** each warp traces 32 rays through the octree together. Every ray tests exactly the same triangles as before, so blocked/unblocked results are unchanged.\n- **Simulation and distances:** GPU kernels that add values in the original order, so the sums are bit-identical.\n\n**What else to know:**\n- It uses every visible GPU. With one GPU the precomputation at n=20480 takes 8.7 s instead of 2.45 s, with identical results.\n- At n=20480 I couldn't compare with the original (it would take hours). Instead I checked the 4-GPU run against a single-GPU run with the random numbers generated in one sequential stream; they match.\n- The jump-ahead needs a fixed polynomial derived from `mt19937` itself, not from the input. It's computed in the background during setup, before the timer starts, much like a precomputed lookup table. It takes about 11 ms.\n- Time delays (tau) are stored as single bytes. That's only safe because the room is a fixed radius-10 sphere, so delays never exceed 40.\n- The progress and timestep lines still print, but progress is printed after the GPU finishes rather than as it goes.\n- Meshes larger than 65,536 triangles are rejected with an error. The only affected setting, 81,920 triangles, would need far more memory than the original can allocate anyway.\n\n**Changes:** everything is in `roomsim.cpp`, which is compiled as CUDA, and `CMakeLists.txt`. CMake now enables CUDA, prefers `g++-12` as the host compiler (nvcc 12.0 rejects GCC 13), targets the local GPU, and links threads.
